allow.key:
styles/base.css :: input:-webkit-autofill,
  input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
  input:-webkit-autofill:focus,
  textarea:-webkit-autofill,
  textarea:-webkit-autofill:hover,
  textarea:-webkit-autofill:focus @ (root)
allow.reason: CHROMIUM AUTOFILL UA-OVERRIDE RECIPE — the :hover member exists to keep the inset box-shadow/text-fill pin on the UA's hover-painted autofill state (the recipe MUST cover :hover/:focus or Chromium repaints its yellow); it is not an interactive hover design, so the (hover:hover) guard does not apply
